title: Manipur Governor and Chief Minister Pay Tribute to Army Captain and Sepoy Killed in Vehicle Accident
summary: Manipur Governor Ajay Kumar Bhalla and Chief Minister Yumnam Khemchand Singh paid tribute to Captain Hanuman Ram and Sepoy Mali Jayesh Himmat at Imphal Airport after their deaths in an Army vehicle accident.
body:
IMPHAL, November 19: Manipur Governor Ajay Kumar Bhalla and Chief Minister Yumnam Khemchand Singh on Thursday paid their last respects to Indian Army Captain Hanuman Ram and Sepoy Mali Jayesh Himmat, who lost their lives after an armoured military vehicle plunged into the Itam River in Imphal East district.

The two leaders attended a solemn farewell ceremony held at the Air Cargo Terminal of Imphal Airport. The deceased soldiers belonged to the 8th Bihar Regiment of the Indian Army.

In a social media message, Chief Minister Yumnam Khemchand Singh expressed grief over the loss of the two personnel and paid tribute to their service and dedication to the nation. He said their contributions would always be remembered with respect and gratitude.

The ceremony was attended by the State Security Adviser, Chief Secretary, Additional Director General of Police and senior officers from the Indian Army, Assam Rifles, Border Security Force and Manipur Police.

**Two Army Personnel Die After Vehicle Plunges into River**

The accident occurred at around 2 pm on November 18 at Lamlai Challou in Imphal East district, when an armoured vehicle carrying four personnel of the 8th Bihar Regiment plunged into the Itam River and remained submerged for some time.

Captain Hanuman Ram, aged 29, was among those rescued after the accident. He later died from his injuries. Sepoy Mali Jayesh Himmat, 24, who was also injured, subsequently succumbed to his injuries at a hospital in Imphal.

The other two personnel injured in the incident were identified as Sepoy Rakesh Sarpate, 37, and Agniveer Akhilesh Kumar Shah, 19. They were taken to BABINA Hospital for medical treatment.

**Investigation into Accident**

The circumstances that led to the armoured vehicle plunging into the river have not yet been fully established. Further details regarding the cause of the accident are awaited.

The deaths of the two personnel have prompted condolences from state authorities and military representatives, as tributes were paid to their service and sacrifice.
author: Mirror Lilong Desk
